overview.title: Executive Overview
overview.summary: Claude Code Proxy translates Anthropic-format API requests to multiple LLM backends (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic) via LiteLLM. It runs as a local FastAPI service on port 8082, enabling the Claude Code CLI to transparently use alternative providers.

blocks.title: Purpose
blocks.description: Drop-in Anthropic API translator. Clients point ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the proxy and continue to speak native Anthropic Messages protocol while requests are routed to the configured backend.
blocks.methodology: FastAPI receives POST /v1/messages, converts to LiteLLM schema, dispatches to backend, converts response back to Anthropic format.

blocks.title: FastAPI + LiteLLM Core
blocks.description: server.py is a single-file FastAPI application (~1,771 lines) that exposes Anthropic-compatible endpoints and proxies them through LiteLLM to backend providers.

phases.title: Translate In
phases.body: convert_anthropic_to_litellm() maps schema + remaps model tier

phases.title: Dispatch
phases.body: LiteLLM routes to backend based on PREFERRED_PROVIDER

phases.title: Backend Call
phases.body: Azure OpenAI / OpenAI / Google / Anthropic executes completion

phases.title: Return
phases.body: Client receives native Anthropic response (streaming or unary)

blocks.title: Fallback Trigger
blocks.body: If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing OR Anthropic returns 404 for a model, proxy retries once on Azure OpenAI using the Azure deployment map.

items: Attempt primary dispatch (Anthropic when PREFERRED_PROVIDER=anthropic)
On 404: set _retried_with_azure=True (prevents loop)
Rewrite model to Azure deployment via AZURE_DEPLOYMENT_MAP
Retry once via LiteLLM azure/<deployment> route
If Azure also fails: surface original error to client

blocks.title: Loop Guard
blocks.body: The _retried_with_azure flag is the single protection against infinite fallback loops. Never remove without replacing with equivalent one-shot semantics.

blocks.title: Provider Selection
rows: Backend router: azure | openai | google | anthropic
Use ADC for Gemini via Vertex

blocks.title: Credentials & Client Auth
rows: Required only when proxying to Anthropic
Optional: gate clients with proxy-local key

blocks.title: AZURE_DEPLOYMENT_MAP
blocks.body: JSON object mapping logical model names to Azure deployment names. 22 entries cover the current Azure OpenAI catalog.

blocks.title: Open-Source Roadmap
blocks.body: Formation completed 2026-04-03: Deepseek-V3 (frontier), Qwen2.5-72B (big), Phi-4 (small) identified as open-source replacements. Self-hosted cost ~$0.80-1.50/1M tokens vs $3.00+ API.

blocks.title: Native macOS Menu Bar Control
blocks.description: Swift/AppKit menu bar utility at ~/Applications/CCP LiteLLM.app that provides live status indicator, model configuration, and login-item toggles.
blocks.methodology: Source: CcpMenuBar.swift, CcpModels.swift. Rebuild via: bash build-menubar.sh

items: Live status dot: green (healthy) | red (down) | amber (starting)
Model Manager: browse Azure catalog, deploy via az CLI
Login-item toggles for both LaunchAgents
Quick-switch BIG/SMALL/FRONTIER without editing .env

blocks.title: Interactive Terminal Model Switcher
blocks.description: Bash TUI at ./ccp-switcher for rapid model tier reconfiguration without opening .env.
blocks.methodology: Modifies BIG_MODEL, SMALL_MODEL, FRONTIER_MODEL in .env and triggers restart.

blocks.title: Usage
blocks.body: ./ccp-switcher — arrow keys to navigate tiers, enter to select model from candidates list.

blocks.title: Registered Agents
rows: Start menu bar app at login

blocks.title: Manual Bootstrap
blocks.body:
launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.ccp.litellm.proxy.plist
launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.ccp.litellm.proxy

blocks.title: Expected Port :8082 Triple-PID
blocks.body: When menu bar app is running, troubleshoot shows 3 PIDs on :8082 — uvicorn main, uvicorn watcher, menu bar health-check socket. This is NORMAL.

blocks.title: ACTIVE SUPPLY CHAIN THREAT
blocks.body: LiteLLM versions 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 were compromised by threat actor TeamPCP (March 24, 2026) via Trivy CI/CD breach. NEVER install these versions.

items: Payload 1.82.7: base64-encoded code injected into litellm/proxy/proxy_server.py
Payload 1.82.8: malicious litellm_init.pth (34,628 bytes), auto-executes on interpreter startup
Capability: steals SSH keys, cloud creds, env vars, CI/CD tokens
Dropper: installs systemd persistence + Kubernetes privilege escalation tools

blocks.title: If 1.82.7 or 1.82.8 ever installed — IMMEDIATE ACTIONS
blocks.body: Assume full environment compromise. Rotate all secrets, audit CloudTrail/Azure logs, and review git history before continuing work.

items: Rotate AWS access keys and session tokens
Rotate GCP service account keys
Rotate Azure credentials (client secrets, managed identities)
Rotate SSH private keys on all machines that touched venv
Rotate CI/CD tokens (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.)
Audit CloudTrail / Azure Activity Log for unauthorized API calls
Review git history for suspicious commits
Run pip audit across all venvs for other compromised packages
Document incident timeline in security review log

blocks.title: Detection One-Liner
blocks.body:
pip show litellm | grep Version
find ~ -name 'litellm_init.pth' 2>/dev/null
pip list 2>&1 | grep -E 'litellm\s+1\.82\.(7|8)'

blocks.body:
ccp-litellm start
ccp-litellm status
ccp-litellm log
ccp-litellm stop
